calibration.question: Does temperature scaling change any decision, or only the ECE?
calibration.note: ECE says the confidence is more honest; AURC says whether that honesty changes a routing decision. They can move independently.

thresholds.question: Do per-bucket thresholds beat one global number?
thresholds.note: Only auto_answerable and out_of_scope have a threshold that bites, so this isolates the out_of_scope difference.

scrub.question: Does removing PII cost classification accuracy?
scrub.note: Not a decision under review -- the scrub is non-negotiable on privacy grounds. This quantifies a cost already accepted.
